# Version 4.156.0
> **Desktop views and rendering reliability** · Released November 9, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.156.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 combines Skia m156 with GTK4 GPU drawing and Uno 7 integration. Linux NoDependencies font discovery returns, Android texture rendering follows display refresh, and font, stream and view lifetimes improve. Review the platform minimums, Uno control changes, GTK4 pixel coordinates and stricter buffer validation before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native libraries now require macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS or Mac Catalyst 15. Raise application deployment targets accordingly, preserving any higher managed or framework requirements. These final floors supersede the earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS 14 baseline changes in this line. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Migrate Uno applications to Uno 7 and .NET 10** — The non-Windows Uno views require Uno 7 and .NET 10; legacy per-platform runtimes and WasmShell linking are retired. Use the .NET SDK WASM pipeline. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, removes RaiseOnUnsupported and paints through a CPU fallback with null GRContext on non-Windows Uno. Remove RaiseOnUnsupported usage and use SKCanvasElement when GPU drawing is required; the WinAppSDK facade remains ANGLE-backed. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Choose GTK4 paint coordinates explicitly** — SKDrawingArea now defaults to physical-pixel CanvasSize and paint Info on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true to retain logical paint coordinates while keeping full-resolution backing pixels. RawInfo stays physical, and GTK input coordinates remain logical. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Target Tizen 10** — Tizen native packages now target net10.0-tizen10.0 and require Tizen 10; Tizen 8 and 9 are no longer supported by these builds. Retarget applications and deploy on Tizen 10. Custom native builds require the Tizen 10 SDK and GCC 14.2 toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **Pass valid text and data buffer lengths** — Negative encoded font-text lengths now throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException, and odd GlyphID byte counts throw ArgumentException. Supply nonnegative lengths and complete 16-bit glyph IDs. SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) also throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array; keep the length within the source buffer. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382), [#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Replace the retired fork-specific WinRT target** — The fork-specific native WinRT target is retired. Move applications relying on it to a supported Windows integration such as WinUI/Windows App SDK. Desktop Windows, WinUI/Windows App SDK and NanoServer remain supported. ([#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))

## Engine

- **Skia m156** — Updates the rendering engine to milestone 156 without adding C bridge exports. HarfBuzzSharp's 14.4.0.100 package revision continues to bundle HarfBuzz 14.4.0 rather than a new engine version. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## API Surface

- **Native GTK4 GPU canvas** — SKGLArea adds PaintSurface, a view-owned GRContext and an optional render loop using GTK's GL context. Use QueueRender for invalidation. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy, which dispatches GL calls for the active context. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux font discovery and shaping coexistence** — Linux NoDependencies discovers installed fonts through its directory-backed manager, defaulting to /usr/share/fonts/ without fontconfig. Bundled HarfBuzz functions bind locally on Linux so a globally loaded system HarfBuzz, including GTK's, cannot redirect internal calls into an incompatible build. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086), [#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Display-paced Android rendering** — Automatic continuous GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows Choreographer display callbacks while drawing remains on the GL worker. Explicit render requests remain independent; this does not impose a fixed rate on every request or guarantee presentation timing. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **More reliable paths and GPU text** — Corrects clipped convex-path rasterization and overflow handling, coverage-mask bounds, reflected hairline square caps, glyph-atlas selection and serialized glyph replay validation. Additional guards handle divergent glyph bounds and oversized glyph allocations. ([#5575](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5575), [#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617), [#5624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5624), [#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631), [#5671](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5671))
- **Shader and Graphite correctness** — Rejects overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types, contains failed shader pipelines and corrects conic-region storage. Graphite fixes cover stroke bounds, paint-key equality, inverse-fill clipping and alpha-to-RGBx readback; GLES no longer receives the invalid BGRA8-as-RGBx upload configuration. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517), [#5575](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5575), [#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **Correct character decoding and callback ABI widths** — StringUtilities decodes single-unit character codes at the requested encoding width; use UTF-32 for supplementary code points. Null byte arrays passed to GetString now throw ArgumentNullException. Native callbacks use the correct Skia bool and HarfBuzz hb_bool_t widths while public managed delegates retain bool signatures. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506), [#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Less allocation when copying image pixels** — Valid managed pixel buffers can be copied directly without an intermediate SKData allocation. Invalid inputs retain the original native-validation path. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Bounded font and borrowed-stream ownership** — DWriteCore custom-font data is released after its last dependent typeface clone is disposed. Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream releases its managed reference to a borrowed stream without disposing that stream; the caller remains responsible for disposal. ([#5577](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5577), [#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Windows and GTK drawing resources release correctly** — WinUI EGL teardown unbinds its own current context before destroying the surface so the native window can be released. GTK4 raster surfaces are disposed before their Cairo-owned backing storage. Native fixes also retain cached WGL entry points' module and correct optional stream callbacks and XPS COM ownership. ([#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551), [#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249), [#5382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5382))

## Platform

- **Matching WebAssembly native assets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp select Emscripten 3.1.34 for .NET 8, 3.1.56 for .NET 9/10 and 6.0.2 for .NET 11+. WebGPU C++ support is now inside libSkiaSharp.a, avoiding C++ flags on application C sources. Custom newer-framework archives must include that support; JavaScript glue remains a link input. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306), [#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Updated Windows native dependencies** — WinUI ANGLE advances to chromium/8118, and Windows library dependencies align with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 without changing the declared runtime minimum. AnyCPU native-asset selection recognizes portable win-x86, win-x64 and win-arm64 RIDs in place of legacy win10-* branches. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5551](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5551))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0, corrects hb_bool_t callback widths and reduces allocations in AddUtf32 string input and feature-string conversion. Its WASM assets align with .NET 11, and its Apple and Tizen native minimums rise alongside SkiaSharp's.

## Release Candidate 1 (November 4, 2026)

The release candidate added Uno 7 integration, display-paced Android rendering, font and stream lifetime fixes, and stricter text/data validation. It also corrected callback ABI widths and Linux HarfBuzz symbol binding, and raised the final Apple floors to macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS or Mac Catalyst 15.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10...v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11)

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced Skia m156, GTK4 GPU drawing and physical-pixel painting, restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, and aligned WASM assets with .NET 11. Tizen packages moved to Tizen 10.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.155.2...v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)
